items.title: Leidos Stock Gets An Earnings Beat As Full Year Profit Outlook Rises
items.summary: Leidos Holdings reported Q3 2026 sales of US$4,630 million and net income of US$410 million, raised full year adjusted earnings guidance, completed a US$504 million buyback of 3,808,570 shares, and declared a quarterly dividend of US$0.45 per share. Management paired higher profitability and guidance with active capital returns through buybacks and dividends, while also securing new long term defense and cyber contracts that shape Leidos Holdings' future workload mix.
